metadata.question: Did Arrachart in Madagascar recieve more than 22 inches of rainfall during the month of January 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about rainfall in Arrachart, Madagascar during January 2020. I need to: 1. Find rainfall data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is a good choice for rainfall 2. Define the location (Arrachart, Madagascar) - I'll use a point geometry 3. Set the date range for January 2020 4. Calculate total rainfall for the month 5. Convert inches to mm (since CHIRPS is in mm) - 22 inches = 558.8 mm 6. Compare and answer I need to handle: - Check if collection has data - Check if valid pixels exist - Validate the calculation CHIRPS data is available as 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const location = ee.Geometry.Point([49.2917, -12.3494]); // Arrachart, Madagascar coordinates const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; const rainfallThresholdInches = 22; const rainfallThresholdMM = rainfallThresholdInches * 25.4; // Convert inches to mm // 2. Data Acquisition const rainfallCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(location); const collectionSize = rainfallCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2020 rainfall images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate total monthly rainfall const totalRainfall = rainfallCol.sum(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: location, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get total rainfall const rainfallMM = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: location, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const rainfallInches = rainfallMM / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${rainfallMM.toFixed(1)} mm (${rainfallInches.toFixed(1)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${rainfallThresholdMM.toFixed(1)} mm (${rainfallThresholdInches} inches)`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (rainfallMM === null || rainfallMM === undefined || isNaN(rainfallMM) || rainfallMM < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (rainfallInches > rainfallThresholdInches) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
